utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what’s the next thing we need to fix?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. First thing is to sort the donated parts and see what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll sort the donated parts and make a missing list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to know the timing and where we’re dropping things off first. I’m just trying to make sure the logistics won’t get messy.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, fair enough — can you confirm the drop-off location and what time you’re aiming for?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can, but I still need the exact drop-off address and a target time window before I commit. Once I have that, I can plan around it and make sure it stays smooth.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I might've missed the details; what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, just whatever you’ve got handy — tools, spare parts, or even a few bucks if that’s easier. I’m trying to get it all together for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I can probably spare a few tools and maybe some cash too — remind me what you still need most?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll tell the others about the repair drive and keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate you keeping folks in the loop. Let me know if you need anything from me while you’re out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll let everyone know and circle back if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, I’m a little late, but I’m here for the repair drive. What do you need me to help with?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Dane — glad you made it. Could you help me sort the donated tools and set up the tables?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure thing, I’ll sort the tools and get the tables set up now.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—just tell me what needs doing and when, and I’ll stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Eli! I’ll get the list together and send you the time and tasks soon.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Quinn—send it over when you’re ready, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How’s the repair drive going—do you need me to bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’d be great, thanks—if you can bring a box of gloves and some packing tape, we’re running low.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure—I can bring gloves and packing tape. Anything else you want me to grab?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m glad the repair drive is coming together — I can help connect folks if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That’d be great, Jules — I’m keeping a little list of who needs what and where they’re located, so your help would make this much easier.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — send me the list and I’ll help match people up with nearby helpers.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to take care of?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — could you help keep a sign-up list and check in with neighbors about what repair items they need?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can keep the sign-up list and check in with neighbors about what they need. I’ll start asking around and jot everything down.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the supply list ready for the repair drive—just tell me what you still need.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, send it over and I’ll grab whatever’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect—I’ll send it right over. If anything’s running low, let me know and I’ll add it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard they’re still looking for a few volunteers and some basic tools for the repair drive. I can ask around and pass along any updates if you want.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Tess. I’d appreciate that—if you hear what tools they still need, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, I’ll keep an ear out and let you know as soon as I hear which tools they still need.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the date and what items are being accepted for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s on Saturday, and they’re accepting broken small appliances, bikes, and simple household items. If you want, I can check whether anything specific is allowed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — can you check whether lamps and toasters are allowed?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — what’s the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m running a few errands anyway, so I can swing by and pick up any repair supplies folks still need.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Nice, that helps a lot — what supplies should I grab?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m going to help organize the repair drive and keep everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s great, Vik — I can help spread the word between the different groups too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, Jules — I’ll keep organizing the repair drive and let you know what each group needs.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I might’ve missed the latest update, but I’m happy to help if you tell me what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. I’m still sorting the list, but I’ll let you know what’s needed as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing—just ping me when you’ve got the list, and I’ll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m glad folks are showing up for the repair drive. What do you need help with first?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I could use a screwdriver set and a pair of pliers first—got a couple loose fittings to tighten up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring those by right away. Point me to the loose fittings, and I’ll help tighten them up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone posted. If you have a list of needed fixes, send it my way and I’ll fold it in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll send over the fixes I’ve noticed and keep an eye on the usual problem spots.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Opal — thank you. I’ll start drafting the drive list and share any updates as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d want to make sure the timing, supplies, and pickup details are all sorted first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll get the timing, supplies, and pickup details pinned down first, then I’ll send you the invite.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help a lot, thank you. Once you have those details, send them over and I’ll see what I can manage.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, this repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes — I’m checking the details now, but as far as I know it’s still on for today.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — can you confirm the time and place once you have it?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to keep it simple—what’s the plan for the repair drive, and when should I be ready?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit behind on the details, but I can jump in and help once I know the time and what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me—just send me the time and a quick list of what needs fixing, and I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming up, but I’m still piecing together the details from everyone else. If you know what they need, I’d really appreciate the update.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve heard they’re asking for basic tools, spare screws, tape, and any small repair supplies people can spare. I’ll keep an ear out for the full list and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that helps a lot. If you hear any more specifics, I’d be grateful for the update.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I meant to bring the drill, but I’m a bit scatterbrained today; I can still help if you point me where to go.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries, Oren — I’m glad you’re here. Can you help me sort the tools by table, and I’ll point you to the drill after that?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely — I can sort the tools by table first. Just point me to the right pile, and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to work around school pickup and drop-off times. What do you need me to coordinate?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Faye — could you coordinate pickup and drop-off support, and let me know the times you can cover?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can cover drop-off from 8:00 to 8:30 and pickup from 3:00 to 3:30, and I can help with a midday run if needed. Just send me the schedule, and I’ll fit it around school.
